input: RGB float32 / 255; letterbox 114, stride32; long sides 640 and 1280
output: [1,300,38] xyxy, confidence, COCO class id, 32 mask coefficients; [1,32,H/4,W/4] mask prototypes
vehicle_minimum_side: 6% of the transferred image's longest side
masks: sigmoid(coefficients . prototypes) cropped to each kept box, threshold 0.5; sent to Flutter as an 8-bit crop and traced into a polygon
